places.name: 霧の廃坑
places.blurb: 灯が届かない坑道。水滴と古い鎚の音だけが残る
places.imageHint: fog-choked abandoned mine tunnels, rotting timber supports, wet stone, lantern haze

places.name: 月灯りの湿地
places.blurb: 月を映した水たまりが、踏み跡をすぐに消す
places.imageHint: moonlit wetland, reed islands, pale reflections, sinking boardwalks

places.name: 赤錆の城門
places.blurb: 門は閉じたまま、錆だけが年を重ねている
places.imageHint: colossal rusted castle gate, flaking iron, crow-perched battlements, dusk

places.name: 塩の灯台
places.blurb: 潮風がガラスを白くし、光は海より陸を探す
places.imageHint: weathered salt-crusted lighthouse on black rocks, storm spray, pale beacon

places.name: 古木の祠
places.blurb: 根が石段を飲み、祈りの札は樹皮に癒着している
places.imageHint: shrine swallowed by an ancient tree, mossy stone steps, paper talismans on bark

places.name: 砂の回廊
places.blurb: 列柱の影が長く、足跡は次の風で王のものになる
places.imageHint: desert colonnade half-buried in sand, long shadows, cracked statues

places.name: 氷の渡し
places.blurb: 川は止まったが、対岸の綱はまだ揺れている
places.imageHint: frozen river ferry crossing, ice-locked barge, rope bridge rime, pale winter light

places.name: 市場裏の井戸
places.blurb: 夜店の裏で、願いより先にコインが沈む
places.imageHint: night market back alley, old stone well, hanging lanterns, wet cobbles

places.name: 風鳴りの峠
places.blurb: 祈りの旗が裂け、声に似た風だけが残る
places.imageHint: high mountain pass, torn prayer flags, wind-carved rocks, thin clouds

places.name: 星落ちの湖
places.blurb: 落ちた星の破片が、岸の砂をまだ熱くしている
places.imageHint: still alpine lake at night, fallen-star shards on the shore, faint aurora

enemies.name: 骨の坑夫王
enemies.blurb: 鎚を忘れず、鉱脈の代わりに命を掘る
enemies.imageHint: skeletal miner king in tattered work leathers, crowned with ore, rusted pickaxe

enemies.name: 灯を食う蛙
enemies.blurb: 光を飲み、残った闇を産卵する
enemies.imageHint: huge marsh frog with lantern-glow in its throat, swallowing light, wet hide

enemies.name: 錆びた番人
enemies.blurb: 鍵を失ったあとも、誰も通さないと誓い続けている
enemies.imageHint: hollow rusted armor warden fused to a great key, iron flakes, empty helm

enemies.name: 潮の灯台守
enemies.blurb: 亡き光を追い、船より先に人を招く
enemies.imageHint: drowned lighthouse keeper draped in kelp and salt, lantern of seawater

enemies.name: 根に棲む獣
enemies.blurb: 祠を守るのではなく、祈る者を養分にする
enemies.imageHint: beast of tangled roots and antlers, soil-crusted fur, shrine moss

enemies.name: 乾いた王の影
enemies.blurb: 王冠は砂、声は風。従う兵は自分の足跡だけ
enemies.imageHint: withered desert king of dust and gold foil, hollow eyes, swirling sand cloak

enemies.name: 白い渡し狼
enemies.blurb: 渡し賃の代わりに、温かいものを求める
enemies.imageHint: enormous white wolf with frost-matted fur, ferry rope in its teeth, ice breath

enemies.name: 欲を飲む蛇
enemies.blurb: 井戸の底で、叶わぬ願いだけを太らせる
enemies.imageHint: long well-serpent with coin-scale skin, eyes like sunk copper, coiled in dark water

enemies.name: 峠の風骸
enemies.blurb: 旗の裂ける音で歩き、名前を風に還す
enemies.imageHint: wind wraith of torn prayer flags and pale bone, howling pass, tattered sleeves

enemies.name: 星喰い
enemies.blurb: 落ちた光を集め、湖より先に空を暗くする
enemies.imageHint: lank celestial eater with a cracked star in its maw, lake-black hide, faint sparks
